question: What is the meaning of builder in relation to general information?
description: A builder in the context of general information refers to a contractor or producer/manufacturer/supplier who designs, constructs, refurbishes, or traces parts of a structure. They are specialists in their own parts of the project and are aware of the availability of their own or third-party materials and raw materials. They may also be involved in the procurement process for constructing or refurbishing the structure.
